sentences.en: Are we to remove our shoes before entering the house?
sentences.zh: 我们进入房子前要脱鞋吗？

sentences.en: The obstacles to our progress have been removed at last.
sentences.zh: 阻碍我们前进的障碍终于被移除了。

sentences.en: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
sentences.zh: 请把那张椅子搬走，因为它挡道了。

senses.zh: 移动，搬开，脱掉，除去，开除，取下，拿走
